prompts.title: Start a new research project
prompts.inputs: the project purpose, intended output, destination, and any research-group conventions.

prompts.title: Organize an existing project
prompts.inputs: the existing project folder and any known current or protected files.

prompts.title: Write CLAUDE.md for a project
prompts.inputs: the project files, existing instructions, and agreed research decisions.

prompts.title: Resume a project
prompts.inputs: the project folder and its project context files.

prompts.title: Leave a useful handoff
prompts.inputs: the current session’s work, checked outputs, and unresolved questions.

prompts.title: Set global user instructions
prompts.inputs: existing instructions and examples of conventions used across projects.

prompts.title: Create a project-scaffolding skill
prompts.inputs: an agreed project layout, setup instructions, and the folder where the agent should save the skill.

prompts.title: Compare research approaches
prompts.inputs: the research question, available data, constraints, and any verified sources.

prompts.title: Make the research specification explicit
prompts.inputs: your research decisions and the questions that still need resolution.

prompts.title: Search and verify the literature
prompts.inputs: the research question, eligibility criteria, and any existing search protocol.

prompts.title: Synthesize the papers actually read
prompts.inputs: verified papers, records of what was read, and the question to address.

prompts.title: Bring approved data into the project
prompts.inputs: approved inputs, their documentation, and the current scientific specification.

prompts.title: Build a modular analysis workflow
prompts.inputs: SPECIFICATION.md, the research data and documentation, and any existing analysis code and results.

prompts.title: Test the workflow before running the full batch
prompts.inputs: the workflow code, input data and documentation, SPECIFICATION.md, and the intended full batch.

prompts.title: Investigate an unexpected result
prompts.inputs: the unexpected result, specification, current code, and saved outputs.

prompts.title: Plan and run known-truth checks
prompts.inputs: the specification and scientific scenarios or performance questions to examine.

prompts.title: Implement the analysis independently
prompts.inputs: the specification, data dictionary, original inputs, and assigned language. Use a fresh agent without access to the other implementation or results.

prompts.title: Compare completed implementations
prompts.inputs: both completed implementations, their outputs, and the common specification.

prompts.title: Design controlled LLM research runs
prompts.inputs: the review-generation and judging protocol, inputs, and permitted tools and services.

prompts.title: Evaluate a frozen labeling procedure
prompts.inputs: the frozen rubric and prompt, evaluation inputs, and acceptance criteria. Keep the human reference labels unavailable during labeling.

prompts.title: Trace numbers into the manuscript
prompts.inputs: the rendered manuscript and saved results, including tables and figure sources.

prompts.title: Draft from the research record
prompts.inputs: the section to draft, research decisions, verified sources, results, and writing guidance.

prompts.title: Draft a response from your decisions
prompts.inputs: reviewer comments, your decisions, and the revised manuscript and analysis records.

prompts.title: Test a clean-copy handoff
prompts.inputs: the project, README, input manifest, reference outputs, and comparison tolerances.

prompts.title: Review a proposed deposit
prompts.inputs: the proposed deposit snapshot, manuscript, input manifest, and sharing requirements.

prompt_groups.project: Set up and maintain a project
prompt_groups.evidence: Define the study and gather evidence
